product.title: Gatsby Moving Rubber Grunge Mat (Grey) Hair Wax 80g
product.body_html:
Grunge Mat is perfect for creating a matte hairstyle without shine, suitable for hair lengths ranging from very short to medium.


BENEFITS

  • Contains the latest "smooth polymer" that provides lightness and leaves no stickiness.
  • Includes Moving Rubber that offers strong hold and allows for easy restyling at any time.
  • Recommended hair length: very short, short, and medium-short.
  • Paraben-free.
  • Refreshing green apple fragrance.

HOW TO USE

  • Apply a small amount to your palm. Evenly distribute it with your hands and apply to your hair, focusing on the ends.
  • Distribute evenly throughout the hair, starting from the roots, and gently lift the ends with your fingertips.

INGREDIENTS

 Water, Euphorbia Cerifera Wax, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Paraffin, Cyclopentasiloxane, Ceteth-20, Mineral Oil, Microcrystalline Wax, Sorbitan Stearate, Butylene Glycol, Alcohol, Stearic Acid, Stearyl Alcohol, PPG-10, Sorbitol, Triethanolamine, Caprylyl Glycol, Dimethicone, Carbomer, Fragrance, PEG-90M, Panthenol, Polyquaternium-11, Red 33(CI 7200).

PRECAUTIONS

  • Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse immediately with water.
  • Discontinue use if redness, rash, or itching occurs. If irritation persists, consult a physician.
  • Keep out of reach of children.
  • Do not ingest. In case of ingestion, seek medical attention.
  • Store at room temperature.
